description: Check a bench test result for a joint actuator against the result format (/api/test/result.schema.json, template at /api/test/result-template.json) and compare the measured values with the part's datasheet in the catalog: peak torque, continuous torque, backlash, Kv, Kt. Returns errors, warnings and each measured-vs-datasheet delta. Nothing is stored.
name: check_test_result

error.description: Set when the tool could not answer; the other fields are then absent.
